legacy.note: FIFA 07 – FIFA 14 (scripts/lib/ea-legacy-seasons.mjs). EA's overall, positions, full name and date of birth come from the ratings files; nationality, club, league, short name and SoFIFA link from the clubs files, whose own rating (bov) is SoFIFA's best overall and is never read. A player missing from either file is left out. Each edition names the roster each file holds and how that is known; where they differ, the season's snapshotDate is the clubs roster's date and ratingsDate the ratings roster's. SoFIFA's dates for FIFA 07–12 are nominal (Aug 30 and Feb 22 every year), so the roster ids identify the snapshots. Evidence that names hugomathien refers to the European Soccer Database (Kaggle hugomathien/soccer), EA ratings by SoFIFA date for 11 European leagues, 2008–2016.

ratings.name: FIFA 21 to FIFA 05 complete player attributes (daguizer, a FIFA Index mirror)

dates.name: SoFIFA's roster dates, each edition's rosters in order (the n-th FIFA 07 date is roster 07000n)

exclusions.evidence: EA id 21195 is Adrian Mutu in FIFA 05 and 'Petrovici Teodor' in FIFA 06 (the ratings files); FIFA 07 gives that name to id 177848, a Romanian striker at Fiorentina. hugomathien names EA id 184410, 'Andrei Murgu' at Fiorentina, Cesena and AC Ajaccio in FIFA 08–13, Adrian Mutu. No edition from FIFA 06 on names Mutu.
EA id 7569 is Marco Materazzi in FIFA 05 and 'Valerio Bernado' in FIFA 06; FIFA 07's id 177844, 'Bernado Valerio' at Inter, is Marco Materazzi in FIFA 08–11 and in hugomathien.

FIFA 08–09's 'Fredric Deboey' (id 184414) takes that place, same club, nationality and birth year, among EA's FIFA 08 stand-in ids; the name is in no other edition.

EA id 33141 is Mahamoudou Kéré in FIFA 05 and 'Daddah Ankoma' in FIFA 06; FIFA 07 gives that name to id 177840, a midfielder from Burkina Faso born in 1982 at Charleroi. FIFA 08–11's 'Amadou Konare' (id 184415) takes that place, same club, nationality and birth year, among EA's FIFA 08 stand-in ids; the name is in no other edition.
